sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates and recommended Beyond Final Scores as the strongest llm-agent deep-read target.
The arXiv metadata, PDF text, source TeX, tables, figures, appendix formulas, discussion, and limitations were read before drafting.
The article extracts AutoLab setup, avg@3/best@3, C1/C2/C3 formulas, experience-reuse interventions, harness ablation, novelty rubric, and key numeric results.
The writeup separates final-score claims from process proxies, controlled-experiment dependence, benchmark/harness dependence, cost comparability, and novelty-scope limits.
